stemMd: A taxi fare is linear in distance. A 4-mile trip costs 17 dollars and a 9-mile trip costs 32 dollars. Which function gives the fare $C(d)$?
explanationMd: The extra five miles cost 15 dollars, giving 3 dollars per mile. Subtract 4×3 from 17 to find a 5-dollar initial fee. The model checks at nine miles: 27+5=32.

distractorRationale.d: The 17-dollar fare already includes four miles.
distractorRationale.b: This interchanges the per-mile rate and initial fee.
distractorRationale.c: This assumes no initial charge and fails the second trip.
